blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jose Rizal University turned to Lawrence Mangubat anew on Friday to down College of St. Benilde, 85-79, and clinch a twice-to-beat advantage in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball quarterfinals at San Juan Arena. Mangubat starred yet again with 27 points built on a blistering 66.7 percent shooting clip as the Bombers hiked their record to 10-3 and secured a crucial advantage in the playoff round.
